## What is in Quercetin 20x Plus?  
**Quercetin Phytosome (Quercefit®)** Quercetin belongs to the flavonoid class of polyphenols and is found naturally in various medicinal plants as well as foods and drinks, including onions, apples, berries, brassica vegetables, nuts, wine, and black tea. The body of scientific evidence demonstrates that ingesting quercetin confers a wide range of benefits to human health, which are primarily mediated through quercetin’s antioxidant activities and immunomodulatory effects. For example, research results have shown quercetin has inhibitory effects on histamine release, eosinophil recruitment, and proinflammatory cytokine activity. Quercetin, like many other flavonoids, has relatively poor absorption in the gastrointestinal tract, causing limited bioavailability.  
**Vitamin C (ascorbic acid)-** Vitamin C is essential to humans and must be obtained exogenously. While most mammals are able to synthesize ascorbic acid, humans lack one of the enzymes required for this process and can quickly become deficient if dietary or supplemental intake is inadequate. Vitamin C also plays a lesser-known role in the deactivation of histamine.
